title: Phone Number Verification: Know Which Numbers Are Real | CrestApps for Orchard Core
description:
A purchased list, an old import or a form typed in a hurry is full of numbers that do not work, and every call to one is agent time that does not come back. Phone number verification in CrestApps for Orchard Core asks an outside service whether each contact's number is real and what kind of line it is, then shows the answer next to the number.

In this video:
• Why numbers are verified, and when a number is checked
• Setting up a provider: AbstractAPI, Twilio or Veriphone, and the general settings
• Reading the status icons: verified, invalid, failed and not checked yet
• Working the Phone Verifications Queue and retrying checks
• Reading the Phone Number Verifications report
• Use cases: before a calling campaign, before a text campaign, and watching for outages
